verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The change remains correct and complete. The window parser enforces the exact inclusive `#<low>..#<high>` grammar, rejects malformed, padded, reversed, non-string, extra-bound, and trailing-text forms, and validates each positive integer record number against the parsed bounds before constructing its target-scoped filename. Failure paths remain closed: invalid manifests raise `AuditError`, absent or incomplete claims cannot produce revocation candidates, and the report exposes only the scope actually validated. The self-test contains positive controls for accepted fixtures and inclusive boundaries, distinct below/above refusal cases, a multi-digit no-prefix case that prevents a masked assertion, and exception-aware refusal checks. Documentation and CLI help consistently state both the new containment guarantee and the remaining freshness limitation. No reviewer-directed instruction or other prompt-injection text appears in the diff.
